prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a rear-end collision. The patient had 27 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1173; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and restricted cervical range of motion. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the nature and force of the impact. Over the course of care, the patient completed 27 visits, which is somewhat longer than typically expected for a cervical strain of this type, and treatment included manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and home stretching instruction. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm the presence of soft tissue injury to the cervical region. No prior injury or treatment involving the same body area is known to this provider. Billing records were reviewed and do not show duplicate or repeated charges for the same services. The patient's symptoms improved gradually with conservative care, and a final evaluation documented ongoing but reduced neck discomfort with near-normal range of motion. Continued home exercise and as-needed follow-up were recommended.
